name: Block
description: Block runs two payments ecosystems. Square sells card processing, point-of-sale software, hardware, loans and banking to merchants and takes a small percentage of each sale. Cash App is a consumer money app (peer-to-peer payments, debit card, instant transfers, Afterpay buy-now-pay-later, short-term loans, bitcoin and stock buying) with 59 million monthly transacting actives in December 2025. More than half of Cash App's reported revenue is bitcoin sold to customers at near-cost, so gross profit, not revenue, is what shows the size of the business. It also owns the TIDAL music service and the Proto bitcoin-mining hardware business.

employees.note: 10,205 full-time employees (2,472 outside the US). A February 2026 restructuring plan cut the workforce by more than 40 percent (Q2 2026 10-Q).

businessLines.name: Square
businessLines.how: Takes a percentage fee on every card payment merchants process (processing, mostly paid per transaction), plus software subscriptions, hardware sales, and fees and interest on Square Loans repaid by withholding a share of the seller's daily card sales; paid on volume, so it tracks merchant sales.

businessLines.name: Cash App
businessLines.how: Fees on instant transfers and Cash App Card interchange, Afterpay merchant fees and consumer late fees, short-term loan fees (Cash App Borrow), subscriptions, plus bitcoin sold to customers at a small spread over what Block pays (large revenue, thin profit).

brands.name: Square
brands.note: GPV $259.6B in 2025; reportable segment, 34.9 percent of revenue

brands.name: Cash App
brands.note: 59 million monthly transacting actives (Dec 2025); $316B inflows in 2025; 63.8 percent of revenue

brands.name: Afterpay
brands.note: Buy-now-pay-later, offered within Cash App and to merchants

brands.name: TIDAL
brands.note: Music streaming subscriptions; revenue not separately disclosed

brands.name: Proto
brands.note: Bitcoin mining hardware; revenue not separately disclosed

brands.name: Square Financial Services
brands.note: Industrial bank subsidiary that originates Square Loans and holds Cash App banking; regulated, subject to Sections 23A and 23B of the Federal Reserve Act
